Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 34 now!
Synopsis :
Seleucus gives back the diamond to Dhananand proving him the fact that the diamond means nothing to him and his dreams. This breaks Dhananand's pride and he wishes to find the person responsible. Furious Dhananand orders to burn Mura alive. Chandragupta gets furious on Chanakya when he comes to know about Mura. Chandragupta saves Mura from the fire and accepts his robbery in front of Dhananand.
